mapper.select: SELECT * FROM service_manifest_sync WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND source_service=#{service} AND delete_flag=0
SELECT * FROM service_manifest_sync WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND delete_flag=0 ORDER BY source_service
mapper.update: INSERT INTO service_manifest_sync (tenant_id,source_service,publication_generation,revision,payload_hash,semantic_hash,sync_status,is_dirty,last_synced_at) VALUES (#{state.tenantId},#{state.sourceService},#{state.publicationGeneration},#{state.revision}, #{state.payloadHash},#{state.semanticHash},#{state.syncStatus},#{state.isDirty},#{state.lastSyncedAt}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,source_service) WHERE delete_flag=0 DO UPDATE SET publication_generation=EXCLUDED.publication_generation,revision=EXCLUDED.revision, payload_hash=EXCLUDED.payload_hash,semantic_hash=EXCLUDED.semantic_hash,sync_status=EXCLUDED.sync_status, is_dirty=EXCLUDED.is_dirty,last_synced_at=EXCLUDED.last_synced_at,updated_at=EXCLUDED.last_synced_at WHERE EXCLUDED.publication_generation > service_manifest_sync.publication_generation OR (EXCLUDED.publication_generation=service_manifest_sync.publication_generation AND EXCLUDED.payload_hash=service_manifest_sync.payload_hash)
